derivation:
simpa [Function.uncurry, Pi.div_apply] using
  continuous_div'.comp_aestronglyMeasurable₂ (g := fun a b => a / b) hf hg
explanation: The general lemma `Continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable₂` (same file, line 263) says that if `G` is a continuous binary operation on the codomain (`Continuous G.uncurry`) and `f`, `g` are a.e. strongly measurable, then `x ↦ G (f x) (g x)` is a.e. strongly measurable. Instantiating the specific binary function `G := (· / ·)` — whose joint continuity is exactly the typeclass field `continuous_div'`, available here from `[Group β] [IsTopologicalGroup β]` via the instance `IsTopologicalGroup.to_continuousDiv` — gives precisely `AEStronglyMeasurable (f / g) μ` (up to the definitional unfolding of `Pi.div` and `Function.uncurry`), in a single application. The library's own proof instead builds the witness `⟨hf.mk f / hg.mk g, …⟩` using `StronglyMeasurable.div'`, so it does not use this declaration. No declaration in Mathlib states the a.e.-strongly-measurable division result directly (`AEStronglyMeasurable.div₀` requires `GroupWithZero β`, `ContinuousInv₀` and `MetrizableSpace β`, none of which follow from `Group β, IsTopologicalGroup β`; `StronglyMeasurable.div'` and `AEMeasurable.div` are about different predicates).
